description: The pure half of `Calendar`: dates as plain `YYYY-MM-DD` strings, the month grid, the keyboard moves of the WAI-ARIA date grid, and the bounds.

## @interlace/calendar-model

Installed to `components/ui/calendar-model.ts`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/calendar-model';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/calendar-model

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
